r0: Merged PR #660 established ClayPackageResolution/v1 exact module-provider resolution, but its symbol semantics remain NOT_SELECTED and executable use remains fenced by PR #648.
Current corpus contains claycode/frank_memory.clay: `use frank.entity.Frank`, while claycode/frank_entity.clay declares `module frank.entity` and top-level `entity Frank`.
Therefore the universal hypothesis `UseDecl.mode == MODULE implies the complete qid is an exact module identity` is falsified by current source evidence.
Draft PR #674 is the active plain-use scope correction and keeps plain-use name binding unselected/fail-closed while retaining exact wildcard module-provider resolution as a candidate.
Parallel namespace/binding candidates must not outrun #674 or create a second provider-resolution authority.
Project trust evidence now requires model-generated PR code to remain non-executing on the persistent self-hosted runner until explicit source admission or ephemeral isolation exists.

counter_reality.strongest_counterhypothesis: Plain-use semantics may include multiple legitimate namespace forms, and longest-module-prefix plus one source declaration may still be the wrong canonical rule even though it explains `frank.entity.Frank`.
counter_reality.consequence: Do not promote the candidate from source shape or local mechanism tests. Select semantics only after #674 scope correction, trusted exact-head execution and nominal-checker integration evidence.

local_mechanism_evidence.interpretation: Bounded mechanism evidence only; the corpus counterexample proved that the initial exact-module reading was semantically incomplete, so the local PASS is not language truth or promotion evidence.

unusual_experiment.name: WILDCARD_BINDING_ORDER_PERMUTATION
unusual_experiment.method: On a disposable synthetic package universe, reverse provider, module, export and use enumeration order; separately include a duplicate visible wildcard name collision.
unusual_experiment.result: Canonical semantic ownership remained byte-identical under the permutations, and the deliberate duplicate visible wildcard name failed closed rather than selecting first/last provider.
unusual_experiment.limitation: This discriminates ordering authority only. It does not establish the correct Clay plain-use or wildcard symbol semantics.
unusual_experiment.accounting: Exactly one unusual experiment was executed by this GO macro-cycle. Unusual experiments recorded by concurrent GO workers are separate cycles and are not merged into this count.

grf_outcome.refuted: Universal exact-module interpretation of every plain use qid.
grf_outcome.retained: Single provider truth plus a separately testable non-executing symbol-ownership layer is architecturally plausible.
grf_outcome.deferred: Specific plain named-import and wildcard visibility semantics until #674 and namespace/binding dependencies converge under a trusted execution surface.
